name: syft
description: SBOM generation tool for container images and filesystems with comprehensive package detection

syft.description: Generate Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) from container images, filesystems, and archives with multi-format output
syft.usage:
syft alpine:latest -o spdx-json
syft dir:. -o cyclone-json
syft docker.io/nginx:latest --scope all-layers
syft packages registry:busybox:latest -o table
syft . -o syft-json | jq '.artifacts | length'
